tagline: Over the Utah line into Pacific time, and on to Baker.
intro: Utah Route 21 comes north through Garrison and crosses the state line as Nevada 487, Baker Road. From there it runs northwest through desert, past pockets of farmland near Baker, and on to US 6 and 50 about seven miles west of the Utah line.
The road was gravel by 1948 and paved by 1949. The park service calls this extremely remote country, with little or no cell coverage and long stretches between gas and groceries.

moments.title: The Utah line
moments.text: At the line Utah 21 becomes Nevada 487, and drivers coming up from Utah cross into Pacific time, as the park service takes care to point out.

moments.title: Baker
moments.text: Forty-one people lived in Baker in 2020, five miles from the park gate, and a Late Show visit in 1997 found it quiet, peaceful, beautiful and friendly.

moments.title: Great Basin National Park
moments.text: Five miles west of Baker on Highway 488 lies the park of Lehman Caves, ancient bristlecone pines and Wheeler Peak, 13,063 feet high.
